prompt: A hyper-realistic, high-resolution photograph of a massive bipedal robot standing in the middle of an industrial maintenance yard. The robot is constructed from heavy-duty black and white mechanical parts, resembling a complex assembly of gears, pistons, and armored plating. It has a humanoid shape but with a tank-like tread system on its head and feet. Red warning lights are visible on its shoulders and chest. The robot's chest plate bears the text "警視庁 MPD" (Metropolitan Police Department). In the foreground, two police officers wearing dark blue uniforms and white helmets stand observing the robot; one officer holds a tablet. Their uniforms also display "警視庁 MPD". Behind them are silver equipment cases labeled "MPD" and orange traffic cones. The background features a large grey industrial building with open bays numbered "02", "03", and "04". The building signage reads "警視庁 MPD" on the left and "整備場 MAINTENANCE YARD" on the right. Several other workers in safety vests and hard hats are visible in the distance near a white truck. The lighting is bright daylight with clear blue skies, casting sharp shadows on the concrete ground.

promptZh: 一张超写实的高分辨率照片，画面中一台巨大的双足机器人矗立在工业维修场中央。机器人由厚重的黑白机械部件构成，宛如齿轮、活塞与装甲板精密咬合而成的复杂装置。它呈人形轮廓，但头部和双脚却配备了类似坦克的履带系统。双肩与胸口处可见醒目的红色警示灯。胸甲上印有“警視庁 MPD”（东京都警视厅）字样。前景中，两名身穿深蓝色制服、头戴白色头盔的警察正驻足观察这台机器人；其中一人手持平板电脑。他们的制服上同样标有“警視庁 MPD”。二人身后摆放着印有“MPD”标识的银色设备箱以及橙色交通锥。背景是一栋灰色的大型工业建筑，敞开的库门上分别标有“02”、“03”和“04”编号。建筑左侧的标牌写着“警視庁 MPD”，右侧则写着“整備場 MAINTENANCE YARD”。远处一辆白色卡车旁，还能看到几名身穿反光背心、头戴安全帽的工作人员。明亮的日光倾洒而下，湛蓝的天空万里无云，在混凝土地面上投下轮廓分明的阴影。
